title: 心理学実験
subtitle: Psychological Experiments
educationalGoal: The purpose of psychological experiments is to find general principles of psychological behavior under strictly controlled conditions. The objectives of this course are to learn about the measurement methods necessary for planning psychological experiments and to acquire the methodological framework of psychology as a science.
advice: Psychological research carries the risk of misunderstanding psychological mechanisms because everyday experiences are influenced by many factors. To avoid this risk, psychologists have developed their own scientific methodology for using various methods to conduct objective measurements. This course prepares students to design their own experiments and provides basic knowledge of factorial design and method of measurement.
requiredKnowledge: This course focuses on factorial design and measurement of psychological methods. Students are required to learn the relationships between the courses of "psychological statistics" and "psychological methods".

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand factorial design and decide which experimental design is appropriate for each study
Ability to interpret data obtained from psychological experiments appropriately
Ability to read and understand articles applying a psychological experiment method
Ability to understand the research methods in the important articles and apply them into your own study
